x: In the International Cross-Country Race at Ayr on March 23rd, Len Herbert ran well to finish 21st, and was fifth man home for England. Congratulations Len, also to David Main, who ran for Ireland, and to our Poly. member, Ron. Hughes, who also scored in the England team.
Our congratulations go to Fred Clay, Dick Towndrow, Rene Howell and Ron Hughes, upon becoming fathers.

Congratulations to our old friends the "Poly" on their third place in the "Southern," ably helped by our own Poly member, Jimmy Wood, who was 23rd. Ron Hughes, who was with us during the war, was an excellent fifth and Rene Howell was 160th.
Hicks, and Ron Hughes, all English Internationals, our lads can be said to have run well in such company.
